must: Upload and export guide before advanced tools
avoid: Automatic map rendering on low-memory devices

decisions: Upload and export tutorial first; orange native controls, existing Minecraft item assets, responsive details and two-column rule controls.
21st File Uploader search reviewed; reuse native inputs instead of introducing React into the vanilla editor.
Optional map preview on low-memory devices; no automatic guide modal.
User-directed Apple-inspired soft surfaces, landscape hero, restrained menus, system font, no green numbered cards, reduced motion and low-memory fallback.
User selected translucent SaaS surfaces, spring-style motion, original pixel W portal mark and compact icon dock below the loaded world map; one control panel at a time.

User selected recognizable black pixel pictograms on a 24px grid, inverted in dark mode; exact export tutorial and creator-hosted texture use two concise resource cards. Tool explanations are scoped to the active panel.

Direct support and tickets in the shared header and account; loaded worlds use a compact dark terrain card with actual metadata and illustrated achievement, builder and chunk actions. Preserve actual free limits and paid access rules.
